verdict.rationale: Godot's official docs describe working entirely from the command line (godot-docs-3, godot-docs-12, godot-probe-4) and running with the `headless` display server and Dummy audio driver on machines without a GPU or display (godot-docs-19, godot-docs-27). A runtime probe confirms the binary installs in one command and runs `godot --headless` for CI builds, exports, and scripted editor automation (godot-probe-rt-1). missing for 10: quoted documentation of the specific export CLI flags and export-template setup, an official CI workflow example, independent hands-on corroboration of headless exports in a CI pipeline
